project: FLUMENX BOS Enterprise RBAC & Security Test Suite

roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Global Wildcard: Master access to all 19 modules, system settings, role manager, and audit logs.

tests.title: Dynamic Role Permission Management
tests.action: Open Role Management. Edit permissions for dynamic roles (e.g., toggle canCreate/canEdit on TASKS) and save.
tests.expected: Roles and permissions update successfully without permission errors.

tests.title: User Administration & Role Assignment
tests.action: Create a new user, change passwords, and toggle active/inactive status.
tests.expected: User CRUD operations execute successfully.
tests.notes: Password hash and dynamic role assignment working.

tests.title: GPS Geofence Policy Management
tests.action: Update office latitude, longitude, and allowed radius meters.
tests.expected: Attendance policy updates and applies to all punch requests.

roles.name: Operations Head / CMO
roles.description: Company-wide View & Edit: Task boards, timeline phases, deliverable monitoring, KPI dashboard.

tests.title: Command Center & Company Timeline
tests.action: View all agency assignments across departments and update deliverable milestones.
tests.expected: All deliverables and company phases are visible and editable.

tests.title: Client Management & Public Share Links
tests.action: Create clients and generate public progress share tokens.
tests.expected: Client portal links generate and render external read-only progress.

roles.name: HR Manager
roles.description: Company-wide Employee Directory (Add/Edit), Leave Approvals, Full Attendance Overview.

tests.title: Company-wide Employee Management
tests.action: Open Employees directory. Verify all staff are listed. Click '+ Add Employee' to create a record. Click 'Edit' on existing employee.
tests.expected: All employees visible; Add and Edit forms work cleanly; Delete button is disabled/hidden.

tests.title: Company-wide Leave Approvals
tests.action: View all submitted leaves across departments. Click Approve or Reject on pending leaves.
tests.expected: Decision updates immediately and status changes.

tests.title: Company Attendance Monitoring
tests.action: View daily punch-in/out records for all employees in IST format.
tests.expected: Accurate timestamps and geo-coordinates displayed.

roles.name: Accountant / Finance
roles.description: Salary Slip Generation, Financial Reports, Attendance/Leave viewing.

tests.title: Salary Slip Generation & PDF Preview
tests.action: Generate monthly salary slips and preview slip calculations.
tests.expected: Salary slips are generated and printable.

tests.title: Payroll & Expense Summaries
tests.action: View payroll summaries and department-wise cost reports.
tests.expected: Finance reports load without errors.

roles.name: Business Development Executive
roles.description: Client Onboarding, Proposal Management, Self Attendance & Leaves.

tests.title: Client Master Management
tests.action: Add and edit client profiles and deliverables contracts.
tests.expected: Client operations succeed.

roles.name: Web Development Team Lead
roles.description: Department-Only Scoping: Web Dev tasks & members only; can create/assign department tasks; department leave decisions.

tests.title: Department Task Scoping
tests.action: Open Task Board. Verify ONLY Web Development tasks appear. Verify Ananthu's Video Editing tasks are hidden.
tests.expected: Strictly department tasks listed. Member filter only shows Web Dev team.

tests.title: Peer Timer Guarding
tests.action: Inspect tasks assigned to team members (Nidhin or Akhil).
tests.expected: Read-only time badge displayed. Start/Stop button hidden and rejected if requested.

tests.title: Task Creation & Assignment
tests.action: Click '+ Create Task'. Assign a task to a Web Dev member.
tests.expected: Task created and assigned to Web Dev member. Cross-department assignment rejected.

tests.title: Department Employee Directory
tests.action: View employee directory.
tests.expected: Only Web Development staff listed. + Add Employee, Edit, Delete buttons are hidden.

tests.title: Department Leave Approvals
tests.action: View leave requests from Web Dev members and approve/reject.
tests.expected: Department leaves visible and decision action works.

tests.title: Unauthorized Route URL Bounce
tests.action: Type /admin/roles or /admin/users in browser address bar.
tests.expected: Immediately redirected to /team-lead/dashboard.

roles.name: Standard Employee (Web Dev)
roles.description: Strictly Self-Service: Own assigned tasks only; own live timer only; cannot create tasks.

tests.title: Own Assigned Tasks Isolation
tests.action: Open Task Board. Verify ONLY tasks assigned to you appear. Verify there is NO '+ Create Task' button.
tests.expected: Only own tasks displayed. Task creation button completely absent.

tests.title: Interactive Live Task Timer
tests.action: Click '▶ Start Timer' on own assigned task. Wait a few seconds, then click '⏹ Stop Timer'.
tests.expected: Timer starts ticking live in seconds. Stop timer accurately records logged duration in time logs.

tests.title: Self Attendance Punch & Logs
tests.action: Click Punch In. Check your record list.
tests.expected: Only personal punch records appear with IST timestamps.

tests.title: Self Leave Application
tests.action: Submit a leave request. Verify there are NO Approve/Reject buttons.
tests.expected: Leave created with 'Pending' status. Decision buttons absent.

tests.title: Sidebar Access Restriction
tests.action: Inspect left sidebar navigation items.
tests.expected: Team Work, Dynamic Roles, User Management, and Settings are completely hidden.
